verdict.rationale: Phaser clearly runs in-browser with lightweight distribution (npm, CDN via jsDelivr) and has long-standing WebGL rendering (built on Pixi.js per community reports), satisfying the 'WebGL today' half of the story. However there is no vendor documentation of WebGPU support, and community evidence explicitly states any WebGPU support is bundled into the stalled Phaser 4 effort with 'not much to say there,' undermining a credible WebGPU roadmap. Missing for 10: official WebGPU renderer docs/timeline, first-party payload-size benchmarks, and confirmation that WebGPU work is actively progressing rather than stalled.
